name: claude-bounce-bridge
description: Bounces the real VS Code Dock icon when Claude Code finishes a turn.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running a task requires a trusted workspace.

commands.title: Claude Bounce: Test Bouncing This Window

claudeBounce.enabled.description: Bounce the VS Code Dock icon when Claude Code finishes in this window.

claudeBounce.repeatCount.markdownDescription: VS Code uses `dock.bounce("informational")`, which bounces exactly once. We therefore re-trigger it while the window has not regained focus. The Dock badge, by contrast, stays on its own until you come back.

claudeBounce.repeatIntervalMs.description: Delay between two bounces, in milliseconds.

claudeBounce.helperBinary.description: Path to the Claude Bounce helper binary, used to tell it we are taking over. Empty means the default location.
